children: Hungary's central bank is preparing to gradually lower its 3% inflation target as part of efforts to meet the criteria of euro adoption, central bank Governor Mihaly Varga said on Thursday.

Varga also told an economics conference that the bank, whose next policy meeting is due on September 22, needs to maintain a disciplined monetary policy framework despite a fall in Hungary's price growth amid serious inflation risks globally.
